## Consulting Models

### Track A: Bespoke Technical Advisory & Audits (Quotation-Based)
Tailored scoping for engineering teams and enterprises with multi-week deliverables.
- Scope:
  - Digital Accessibility & EAA/BFSG Readiness: Comprehensive WCAG 2.2 AA audits, screen reader/TalkBack UX evaluation, design system audits, and European compliance roadmaps.
  - Android Architecture & Code Audits: Compose performance profiling, modularity analysis, build speed optimization, and codebase health reviews.
  - Custom Technical Content Reviews: Fact-checking and WCAG audits for technical publications (from €200).
  - Custom Engineering Interview Loops & Hiring Rubrics.
- Workflow: 4-Stage Advisory Process (Discovery -> Proposal -> Kickoff with 50% advance -> Delivery/Walkthrough -> Final settlement).
- Primary Action: Complimentary 30-Minute Discovery Session via Cal.com.
